newsitem.title: UK: UK to raise 350 mln stg from new VAT retail scheme.
newsitem.headline: UK to raise 350 mln stg from new VAT retail scheme.

text.p: The British government said on Tuesday it expected to raise some 360 million stg in 1997/98 by updating retail schemes used by store owners to account for VAT.
The Customs and Excise will withdraw the standard method of calculating takings to remove an anomaly which gives a cash flow advantage to businesses providing in-house credit.
Customs will also impose a turnover cap on one of the schemes to reduce the potential for manipulation.
In future special schemes used by many retailers to account for VAT will only be available to businesses which cannot reasonably be expected to account for tax in the normal way.
After the first year the government expects the change will raise about 25 million stg annually.
